'''2006 World Championship 6 V-Card Tournament Mike Rebman DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Rebman]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (6 V-Card Tournament); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2006-11-04).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35781 Mike Rebman's 6 V-Card Deck - Ral Ops]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213230502/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35781 Internet Archive]</ref>
